In [[3 ABY]], the [[Azzameen family]] made an assassination attempt on [[K'Armyn Viraxo]].

Following the [[Viraxo]] family's collaboration with the [[Galactic Empire]] to [[Imperialization of Azzameen assets|close down and capture]] the Azzameen family business, [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]], the surviving patriarch of the Azzameen family, [[Antan Azzameen]], led the surviving Azzameens on a crusade to destroy the Viraxo and reclaim their former holdings. To that end, Antan Azzameen obtained information indicating that his opposite number K'Armyn Viraxo, Viraxo family patriarch and head of [[Viraxo Industries]], would be passing through the [[Destreg system/Legends|Destreg system]] with minimal escort. Seeing this as an opportunity to strike his enemy at a vulnerable moment, Antan enlisted his nephews, [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] and [[Emon Azzameen]], to ambush Viraxo's [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|yacht]], the ''[[Highroller]]''.

Unfortunately for the Azzameens, the situation was a trap. The ''Highroller'' was operating on remote, and K'Armyn Viraxo was not aboard. Rather than the limited escort the Azzameen [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were expecting, two [[Muurian transport]]s escorted by eight [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] and an Imperial [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|gunboat]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] appeared to intercept them. The Azzameens barely escaped the Destreg system with their lives.

Before departing, however, Ace Azzameen sent a message to the Viraxo. He destroyed the unmanned ''Highroller'', and took the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] steering wheel as a trophy. His uncle Antan apologized for the failure in [[Spy/Legends|intelligence]], but was sure that the Azzameens' show of force would cause the Viraxo to hesitate before crossing the Azzameens again.

==History==
===Background===
{{Quote|Although Aeron agreed some form of revenge was due, she expressed distaste for Uncle Antan's plan. She was about to say more when communications with her failed. Odd.|MK-09's post-mission report|<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide">[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>}}
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="date" /> shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]],<ref name="xwaopen">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'', opening cutscene</ref> [[Tomaas Azzameen/Legends|Tomaas Azzameen]], head of [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]], was killed along with his son [[Galin Azzameen/Legends|Galin]] in the act of providing [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]].<ref name="xwab0m6">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' Battle 0, Mission 6: "Rebel Rendezvous: Aid to the Alliance"</ref> As penalty for this act of [[Treason/Legends|treason]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the family's business and other assets were [[Imperialization of Azzameen assets|were seized]], and arrest warrants were issued for the surviving Azzameens.<ref name="xwab0m7">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' Battle 0, Mission 7: "Nowhere To Go?: Escape Imperial Attack"</ref>

The Azzameens scrambled to save as many assets as they could, but had to work against both Imperial forces and their long-time rivals, the [[Viraxo]], who worked with the Imperials against the Azzameens. While [[Antan Azzameen|Antan]] and [[Emon Azzameen]] were retrieving cargo from a Twin Suns storage facility, a joint Imperial-Viraxo force captured Antan, who was now the surviving patriarch of the family, and also nearly captured Emon. Meanwhile, a Viraxo [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] joined an Imperial force was capturing [[Twin Suns Station]], the family's [[Repair Yard|repair yard]], and they attempted to capture [[Aeron Azzameen|Aeron]] and [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] as they retrieved a cache of [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]] stored there.<ref name="xwab0m7" />

Ace and Aeron Azzameen rendezvoused with their brother Emon at their home, [[Azzameen Station/Legends|Azzameen Station]], only to find it under attack by an Imperial task force led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Garreth Holtz/Legends|Garreth Holtz]], who was joined by even more Viraxo forces. The three young Azzameen family members had no choice but to flee to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], using coordinates they were given by [[Olin Garn]], a Rebel friend of Aeron's. There they were given shelter by Rebel Admiral [[Nammo]] of the [[Defiance Task Force|''Defiance'' Task Force]].<ref name="xwab0m7" />From this temporary base, Aeron and Emon set out to consolidate the remaining Azzameen assets and locate a temporary base of operations, while Ace Azzameen remained behind to join the Rebellion. Soon after, Emon Azzameen ordered MK-09 to fetch Ace from the ''Defiance''<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide" /> to execute a [[rescue of Antan Azzameen]] from the [[Viraxo Industries]] [[XQ5 Platform|platform]]. After they successfully liberated their uncle, Antan Azzameen told the boys that he would contact them soon with plans to strike again.<ref name="xwab1m2">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' Battle 1, Mission 2: "Rescue Uncle Antan"</ref>

Shortly after the ''Defiance'' Task Force carried off an [[Battle of Bettel|operation]] that seriously embarrassed the family's Imperial persecutor, Admiral Holtz,<ref name="xwab1m6">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' Battle 1, Mission 6: "Stop Resupply of ISD Corrupter"</ref> Antan Azzameen was true to his word. He contacted his niece and nephews and summoned them to the temporary Azzameen base of operations to discuss a plan for revenge against the Viraxo.<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attempted assassination of K'Armyn Viraxo appears only in the [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|personal computer]] game ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'', which was developed for [[LucasArts]] by [[Totally Games]] and released on [[February 28]], 1999.<ref name="xwa" /><ref name="This Week! Ep5">{{ThisWeek|aXaqpI-IARE|Star Wars: The High Republic Debuts, The Magic Behind The Mandalorian, and More!|sw_url=video/star-wars-the-high-republic-debuts-the-magic-behind-the-mandalorian-and-more}}</ref> The primary objective of the in-game mission is only to "inspect" the ''Highroller'', meaning to get within half a [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] according to the measurements of the game engine, and then escape. However, destroying all Viraxo ships is a "bonus goal" in the scenario,<ref name="xwab2m3" /> and the [[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|official strategy guide]], which is written primarily from the first-person perspective of MK-09, assumes that the Azzameens will destroy both the Viraxo and bounty hunter forces before fleeing from the Imperials.<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide" />

This mission, as with most missions in ''X-Wing Alliance'', is not specifically dated by the game or secondary sources. Its timing can only be estimated by preceding and succeeding events that have been given specific dates, but it can be placed in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] by the fact that all of ''X-Wing Alliance'' occurs after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], which sources generally agree occurs in 3 ABY, most specifically ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The assassination attempt also precedes a series of missions in ''X-Wing Alliance'' that ties into the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|''Shadows of the Empire'']] meta-series, which is dated to "3.5 ABY" by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

''X-Wing Alliance'' was included in the continuity now known as "[[Star Wars Legends|Legends]]" along with most other ''Star Wars'' materials produced before [[April 25]], [[2014]].<ref name="FUDisney">{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}}</ref> As it was the final game in the [[X-Wing (game series)|''X-Wing'' series]] and as LucasArts is now closed,<ref name="seriouslyFUDisney">{{WebCite|url=http://www.joystiq.com/2013/04/03/disney-closes-lucasarts|text=Disney closes LucasArts|author=Sliwinski, Alexander|date=2013-04-03|language=English|quote=Disney, which acquired Lucasfilm and LucasArts last year in a $4.05 billion deal, has shut down the legendary LucasArts division.|archivedate=20130403205142}}</ref> the fates of the Azzameen and Viraxo families will likely remain unknown.
